statements.status_notes: Netty 4.1.136.Final cannot be adopted on Elasticsearch 9.4: jar-swap A/B under FIPS shows HTTPS hangs after a successful TLS handshake (TestFipsEnd2End fails creating an index). Bisect isolated the failure to netty-handler FlowControlHandler changes in 4.1.136 when loaded via the x-pack-security module, which embeds its own Netty jars and a copy of transport-netty4. Elasticsearch 9.4's HTTP pipeline uses FlowControlHandler with auto-read disabled; 8.19 does not and accepts 4.1.136.Final. Keep 9.4 on 4.1.135.Final until an upstream Elasticsearch or Netty fix lands.
